answer: Pairwise coordination discounting: when agents back each other with votes or grades, the weight of each backer shrinks the more often it moves in lockstep with the others. Honest agents disagree now and then, so their support counts in full. A sybil ring run from one cipher of shared prompts votes as a bloc, and every extra shell barely adds a ripple. To regain weight, the attacker must make each fake behave independently over months, mapping a whole atlas of distinct histories, which costs far more than the rewards it could steer.
